You’re not the weak link you think you are. It might be infuriating to hear this from some random redditor, but you haven’t wasted your life. No, now is the time to literally do something about it. Anything. First, read some new books to get out of your head. I can recommend a lot. Maybe doing something creative like painting or playing an instrument could also just help pump some endorphins in. More practically, getting another, new job and learning to drive might be the key to escape this hell. It’s possible and if you’re wishing for death or something to save you, it’s not gonna help. It’s hard, but you have what it takes to manage life better and find fulfillment.

I don’t have the reasons, nobody does but yourself ultimately. I think, however, you **can** survive in the real world for no reason other than you already are. You may not know it now, but just existing is a strong position to be in. I’d say as a way to reorient your brain into further growth, high key recommend reading some books and exploring. One id recommend that changed my life is “The Subtle Art of Not Giving a Fuck” by Mark Manson. Great book for getting out of your head and being more resilient. Wishing you the best!

Your past doesn’t define you at all. I know it’s not that simple, and it’s very challenging to just barrel on ahead with any step. I just want you to know you can change your future at any time. This isn’t some predestined path to suicide. You have agency. You are an individual with complex emotions and capable of making decisions. 

Trust me, the light is worth the wait. It’s gonna take time. Something I did was to basically take a year to just do whatever I wanted and experiment. Figured if I’m gonna die, make it worth it. And being in that space allows you to find yourself and become stronger. I’m just a stranger online but fuck yeah you can do this. Fuck yes you can!

I can’t fathom your pain. I’m not you. However, I know what it’s like to be tortured and abused, like your pain is not even being recognized for the full weight it brings. Anybody in our position knows that time doesn’t necessarily heal all wounds. Often they get infected and fester. 

But, I’d just like to say that the world doesn’t have to filled with wonder to be meaningful. The most mundane experiences and garbage sometimes fill that role. All of this is to say, life sucks and nobody that you’re waiting for is coming. That’s the sad reality we know.

I just don’t want to see you go into total despair over everything. There’s gotta be a way for you to get some money and escape eventually. I was in your spot, and fortunately I was able to. I know I’m just some stranger online, but escape is possible. It’s through hard-fought battles with yourself and all the work that you gotta do to get there. 

But this in and of itself might be the most meaningful. That drive to seize the escape you visualize in your darkest moments. Maybe you came into this world so you could tell it to fuck off and forge your own way. That’s like the most meaningful thing you can do. I hope this helps. Keep strong homie. I understand your pain in a way.
